name: marker-highlights
description: Highlights configurable [tag[ ... ]tag] inline/zone markers in the Markdown preview, with one color per tag.
author: David E. Osorio

markerHighlight.markers.markdownDescription: Reviewer markers to highlight in the Markdown preview. Each entry's `tag` matches `[tag[ ... ]tag]` in the document; `color` is any CSS color. Multiple entries can be active at once, e.g. one per reviewer.

color.description: CSS color used to highlight this tag's markers, e.g. "#f0a558".
